One Camera, Decades of Possibilities

Blending instant photography, video capture, and advanced connectivity into a single compact device, the FUJIFILM instax mini Evo Cinema Hybrid Instant Camera transforms everyday moments into tangible, cinematic keepsakes. Inspired by the Super 8 film cameras of the 1960s, its vertical grip design, analog-style controls, and tactile print lever create a shooting experience that feels as nostalgic as it is modern. With the ability to capture stills, record short video clips, and instantly print on instax mini film, the mini Evo Cinema delivers a uniquely immersive way to create, hold, and share memories.

Hybrid Capture & Instant Playback

Designed as a true three-in-one camera, the mini Evo Cinema records photos and up to 15 seconds of video while also functioning as a wireless smartphone printer. Video clips can be stitched together in-camera or via the instax mini Evo app, where they can be trimmed, reordered, and enhanced with cinematic opening and end titles before being shared.

Capture videos up to 15 seconds long
Convert videos into instax prints with scannable QR codes
Replay or download videos by scanning the QR code on a smartphone
Functions as a smartphone photo printer via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi

Gen Dial Creative Effects

At the heart of the mini Evo Cinema is the Gen Dial, a tactile control that recreates the visual and audio character of different decades of imaging history. From the grainy charm of 8mm film to the polished look of modern digital media, each effect reshapes both video and stills with era-accurate textures, color, noise, and sound.

10 decade-inspired effects from the 1930s to the 2020s
10 adjustable intensity levels per decade enable 100 unique looks
Audio matches each visual style, with select sounds such as the whir of film reels
Stills Capture with Instant Film Printing

- Kompatibel luas dengan kamera mirrorless dan DSLR mainstream Canon, Nikon, Sony, dan Fujifilm.
- Kepala flash bulat cocok dengan aksesori pemasangan NEEWER CRM2/M12/CRS6/CRS7/CRB1/S2 untuk memperluas efek pencahayaan kreatif.

Pengisian & Daya Baterai 
- Baterai internal lithium 7.2V 3000mAh.
- Desain pengisian USB Type C; waktu pengisian penuh hingga 2,5 jam.
- Mendukung 600 flash daya penuh dengan waktu pemulihan cepat 1,5 detik.
